description: This short circular walk explores Bargain Wood from the Whitestone car park north of Chepstow. It's a nice peaceful area for a walk with pretty bluebells in the spring and lots of woodland birds to look out for. On the eastern side of the wood there's also the River Wye. You can continue your walking in the area on the Llandogo Cleddon Falls Walk and visit Tintern Abbey and Tintern Old Station which lie just to the south.
